name: Sambhav Jaiswal

education.degree: Bachelor of Technology in Civil Engineering — CGPA: 7.05 / 10

bullets: Built AI-powered backend services in Python, FastAPI and LLM APIs to automate business workflows.
Developed a RAG pipeline for document Q&A: ingestion, chunking, vector search and LLM response generation.
Executed exploratory data analysis on large-scale financial datasets using generative AI, identifying high-risk delinquency indicators with 100% data-integrity validation.
Designed a predictive-modeling framework and an agentic-AI collections strategy for stakeholder risk reports.

projects.name: Algorithmic Trading Signal Predictor
bullets: Built an end-to-end ML pipeline over 68,000+ rows of 60-minute OHLCV data for 15 NSE equities, ingesting CSV, JSON, SQLite and REST API sources.
Engineered 51 stationary features after removing leakage-prone columns, validated with walk-forward cross-validation and a 50-hour purge window.
Benchmarked 8 classifiers (Naive Bayes, Logistic Regression, k-NN, SVM-RBF, Decision Tree, Bagging, Random Forest, AdaBoost); tuned Bagging reached 91.2% test accuracy and Naive Bayes 0.99 recall.

projects.name: DSA Layered Study System
bullets: Zero-backend React SPA: 76-lesson, 19-module DSA curriculum at 4 tiers, dependency-gated module graph.
Spaced-repetition queues, mistake logs, timed interview drills and a client-side weakest-module radar.
GitHub Actions CI: schema-validated lesson JSON, ESLint 9, auto-deploy to GitHub Pages (MIT licensed).

projects.name: AI Video Re-Dub Pipeline
bullets: Built an offline 7-stage video re-dubbing pipeline: ffmpeg extraction, faster-whisper STT, Llama 3 cleanup via Ollama, XTTS v2 speech with edge-tts fallback.
Freeze-frame segment rebuilds keep narration in sync; watchdog folder monitoring auto-triggers runs.

projects.name: GreekG Assistant — Offline Voice Assistant
bullets: Hotkey dictation on Windows: on-device faster-whisper STT, local-LLM cleanup, paste into the active app.
Wake-word trigger, fuzzy voice app launcher, Word logging and an OpenAI-compatible API fallback.

projects.name: Hardware-Aware Portfolio

GPU-detection hook serving physically based materials on discrete GPUs, wireframe fallbacks on integrated ones.
